ns2:section.sectionText: Professional Skills in Information Science-In this course, students will learn about and develop professional skills in the information sciences, a broad and interdisciplinary field at the intersection of people, information, and technology. Students will engage in professional skill building for a broad range of employment in the information professions with a specific focus on internship and career readiness. Restricted to Information Sciences majors until 12/1/22 by noon. We will not provide overrides, please wait until the course restrictions are removed. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
